notes: kb/Work PB322 determination A LANDED (w1013m): the sharing mode established for a connector with neither a SHARING phrase nor a SHARING clause is one of the three standard modes chosen by the OPEN mode (INPUT = READ ONLY, otherwise NO OTHER), also for a LOCK MODE-only SELECT and for an OPEN whose only phrase is RETRY (both register no sharing, so SharedOpenAttempt falls through to the default). Witnesses: the golden's A/B/C/L connectors (the DOC-A.1-131 example statuses) and the clause-less reader that sees another connector's record lock. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/IO/FileRegistry.cs#Conflicts (FileRegistry.Conflicts was deleted; Table19.Conflicts is the one arbitration lookup) Band 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB6130): the item documents the sharing mode an implementor establishes when neither a SHARING phrase nor a SHARING clause is written (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR23; §2002:14.8.26.3 GR22; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex B.1 items 58 and 104). ANSI X3.23-1985 has no sharing mode and no such item in its Implementor-Defined Language Element List, so no 1985 text leaves this latitude. At --std 85 there is no sharing mode to document: 1985 keys I-O status 41 to the physical file (§1985:II.2; §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR5; §1985:VII.1.3.5), so a second file connector's OPEN of a physical file another connector of the run unit holds open answers 41 (kb/Work PB6161, the owner's decision of 2026-11-24, which replaced PB670's option (i)). That is 1985's own rule, not this item's latitude.
